SELECT Pl_Date, Pl_number, Pl_title, Pl_Flag, Pl_FileFlag = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Pl_ImgNum, '') = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END, Pl_FileName = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Pl_ImgNum, '') <> '' THEN ( SELECT MAX(Af_filename) FROM File_DB.dbo.I_AddFile WHERE Af_Num = Pl_ImgNum ) ELSE '' END, Pl_ImgNum, Pl_Gub, Pl_buser, Pl_silbuser, Pl_partflag, Pl_BFlag, Pl_RegDate, Pl_UserID FROM I_Proposallist
AND UPPER(Pl_Title) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%'
AND CONVERT(date, Pl_Date) BETWEEN CONVERT(date, #{searchFromDate}) AND CONVERT(date, #{searchToDate})
ORDER BY Pl_Date DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
